title: Return-lineage defect audit (Projects 04-07): DD Only / Combined DD+Vol

defect.mechanism: double-lag base-return recovery: base_ret = portfolio_return / portfolio_dd_exposure.shift(1), while the stored portfolio_dd_exposure is ALREADY the lagged applied exposure (exp_005 cell 82 persists portfolio_exp.shift(1)). Correct inverse is same-row divide.
defect.spurious_factor: portfolio_exp[t-1]/portfolio_exp[t-2] on each day exposure moved (2327/2558 days)
defect.internal_contradiction: same function recovers the BOOK with /exp (same-row, correct) but the RETURN with /exp.shift(1) (defect) — mutually inconsistent inverses of one scaling
defect.why_v1_clean: V1 uses the shipped portfolio_return directly (ret=pr.copy()); it never passes through the recovered base, so it is defect-free and reconstructs from exp_004 to ~1e-16.

impact.DD Only: CORRECTED — gross CAGR 40.71%->37.21%; Sharpe improvement vs V1 SURVIVES (net p 0.0004->0.010); MDD improvement SURVIVES (~6.98pp, p=0.0009); CAGR advantage DISAPPEARS (+3.1pp->-0.3pp, p=0.58)
impact.Combined: CORRECTED/INVALIDATED edge — gross CAGR 42.56%->38.74%; Sharpe improvement vs V1 NO LONGER SIGNIFICANT (net p 0.011->0.20); CAGR edge collapses (+4.9pp->+1.1pp); MDD improvement weak (p=0.10)
impact.turnover_costs: VALID basis — computed from actual position books (compute_turnover(book)); correction shifts mean turnover <0.001 and cost drag <0.02pp/yr (second-order via exposure path)
impact.white_reality_check: VALID — winner P04:ls_20pct (raw, defect-free); p=0.0103 identical old vs corrected
impact.deflated_sharpe: VALID — candidate under test is V1; trial-variance input mildly corrected, DSR stays ~0.99999
impact.monte_carlo_nb03: drawdown conclusions VALID (dynamic replay already used canonical base); method-B CAGR/Sharpe for DD/Combined resampled the defective shipped series (documented)

cost_convention: one-way turnover * 10 bps; gross & net both reported; borrow/financing NOT modelled (pre-existing limitation)
non_overwriting: all upstream artifacts read-only; outputs isolated to exp_007_research_integrity_audit/
